_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: The Open University's BA (Honours) History (Q01) qualification structure -- its three 120-credit stages and the compulsory/optional modules that make them up -- cross-checked against the QAA Subject Benchmark Statement: History (March 2022)
_items_source.version: Q01 qualification page and module list (open.ac.uk/courses/qualifications/q01 and the individual module pages for A111, A113, A223, A225, A327/A328/A329/A340/A344), and QAA's Subject Benchmark Statement for History (published 2022-03, current at qaa.ac.uk), itemised 2026-09-27. The OU's B01/Q01 register listing on msds.open.ac.uk was checked but returned only a login-gated student-services shell, not the public qualification description; the public qualification page (open.ac.uk/courses/qualifications/q01) and the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences history pages (fass.open.ac.uk/history/qualifications) were used instead.
_items_source.numbering: The OU publishes Q01 as a stage/module structure (Stage 1: A111 + A113; Stage 2: A223 + A225; Stage 3: one or two of A328/A327/A329/A344/A340/DA332/CDDR301/CDDR321), not a numbered syllabus of sub-topics the way an exam board does -- the unit-by-unit content of each module sits behind the OU's student VLE and was not accessible. This course therefore codes its own topic breakdown, in the standard, well-established form found in any history-degree reading list or textbook for each period: L4.* for the Stage-1 (Level 4) block (HM = historical method/historiography, ER = the English Revolution, AR = the Atlantic Revolutions, CR = comparing revolutions), L5.* for the Stage-2 (Level 5) block (RE = Reformation/confessional Europe, SF = state formation/Enlightenment, IB = industrialising Britain, EI = empire/Ireland/suffrage), and L6.* for the Stage-3 (Level 6) specialist block (WW = WW1/Russian Revolution, IF = interwar crisis/fascism/Stalinism, WH = WW2/the Holocaust, CW = Cold War Europe and 1989), numbered .1-.3 within each topic in this course's own teaching order.
